prompt:
A single forged letter made of light, standing alone on a plain dark background.
THE LETTER: the Devanagari letter द — a deep rounded curve open to the left, with a straight upright line rising along its right side, joined at the top by the flat headline stroke that Devanagari letters carry.
MATERIAL: the letter is made of warm golden light with a soft glow around it, as though a thin ribbon of gold were standing upright in the air. Its surface has the same soft cut-paper quality as the rest of this world, with a fine paper grain visible inside the glow.
The background is plain deep blue-black, so the letter's own light is the only light in the picture.
The letter stands upright and centred, seen straight on, filling most of the frame.
